decoded_fp32_parity.scope: Single-pass model-only decoded text agrees between JAX browser FP32 and ONNX Runtime CPU FP32 for baseline and four diagnostic profiles on complete dev/test. Python uses batch size one and the original exported HF tokenizer files.

browser_measurement.latency_scope: Loaded engine sentence analysis; includes first-use JIT for new shapes. Conditions run rules, model, combined, each with one/two passes. Earlier conditions warm caches; combined-mode timings are not independent speedups. Startup is separate. No physical GPU latency claim.

c4.attribution: Stahlberg and Kumar (2021), Google C4_200M; parquet conversion by martinsr
c4.license_scope: Original project licenses corruption edits CC-BY-4.0; preserve source-corpus notices too.
c4.quality: synthetic weak supervision; not reviewed natural errors
c4.selection: First valid rows of pinned stream, bounded; not a random sample

glm_completed.review_status: Unreviewed train-only weak supervision; structural validation is not grammar validation.

glm_frozen_training_pool.note: Frozen while generation continued; the additional rows in the completed corpus were not used by these four students.

schema_coverage.scope: Same fixed1000-row C4 sample; preparation representability, not correction accuracy.

decision: No student promoted. Bundled weights retained; local AI remains experimental and opt-in.

promotion_gates.scope: Neural deployment policy in both FP32 and INT8; actual JAX browser dev must also qualify. Does not certify the existing rules engine.
promotion_gates.support_note: 25 edits is an operational evidence floor, not statistical certification. Same frozen arms were rerun after a prior dev trial qualified on only 1-5 predictions.

scope: Aggregate results only; no benchmark text, teacher rows, checkpoints, or browser state.

scoring.limitations: Fluency references include stylistic rewrites. Best-reference selection can change reference edit counts between conditions. Scores are not universal grammar accuracy.
scoring.method: Actual ERRANT token-span extraction; best sentence reference by F0.5, then TP, then fewer FP/FN. Not official JFLEG GLEU or the official ERRANT comparison CLI.
scoring.no_edit_precision: null means no predicted edits; it is not evidence of correction quality.
scoring.population: JFLEG ee06ff806a208aba815ac45313f4e750a48330a5: 754 dev and 747 test, four references per sentence.

training.limitations: One seed and schedule; no uncertainty estimates. All training rows fit 64 WordPieces, so 128 compares inference context rather than long-context training. Template and mixed label inventories differ.
